Alger, 5 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 5, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The UN General Assembly adopted a resolution backed by Togo and the African Union to promote the use of global map representations that are true to the actual size of the continents. This text, which aims in particular to enlarge Africa and reduce the size of the United States, gathered one hundred and sixty-four votes in favor.
Une adoption marquée par une large major: An adoption marked by a large majority and American opposition
Le texte soumis à l'Assemblée générale a: The text submitted to the General Assembly was adopted by one hundred and sixty-four votes to one, namely that of the United States, along with six abstentions. The resolution was brought forward by Togo and the African Union, while also benefiting from co-sponsorship by France. It encourages member states as well as international organizations to favor the use of "Equal Earth" type map representations.
Cette orientation scientifique implique: This scientific orientation implies the gradual abandonment of the so-called "Mercator" projection, designed in the sixteenth century by the geographer, cartographer, philosopher, and theologian Gerardus Mercator, born in Flanders in 1512. Initially conceived to meet the needs of maritime navigation, this projection method generates distortion by artificially enlarging territories located at high latitudes. According to the terms of the resolution, this visual anomaly tends to diminish the perceived surface area of Africa, Latin America, and South Asia, thereby perpetuating an unbalanced perspective of the globe.
Intervenant à la tribune, le ministre de: Speaking at the rostrum, Togo's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Robert Dussey, insisted on the influence of maps on collective representations and education, emphasizing that they are never neutral. He specified that the approach targets no nation or particular cartographic tradition, but responds to a universal ambition based on scientific rigor and truth.
En réaction, la représentante américaine: In reaction, the US representative Yaryna Ferencevych sharply criticized the initiative, considering that it harms the institution's credibility and deflects debates from emergencies related to international peace or prosperity. For his part, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot, speaking at the Sorbonne, affirmed that correcting this distortion constitutes an act of truth.
Le texte préconise l'utilisation de la p: The text advocates for the use of the "Equal Earth" projection to the detriment of the Mercator one.
La mesure vise à corriger la distorsion: The measure aims to correct the distortion that reduces the visual size of Africa, Latin America, and South Asia.
Les États-Unis ont voté contre le texte,: The United States voted against the text, while Togo, the African Union, and France supported the initiative.
